Dialogue.line:19ca56d3: Anyways, for now use the console to run the new system update.

Dialogue.line:1643a30a: I’m seeing another smoke to my west, looks like we got another camper.

Update me tomorrow morning.

Don't travel any further than half a mile or so north of your tower

ep3_controls.NewsContent1: (Hunter News) - It's not unsual for audience to be nosy about some of the celeberities' personal matters but sometimes it's just too overbearing. We see something similar with the case of Roy Carson, the COO and co-founder of BN Media, after his very public breakup and divorce with his wife, former actress Allisa Brown Carson, has allegedly been receiving death threats from the fans of Allisa Brown for the rumoured infidelity that underwent within the said relationship.
ep3_controls.NewsContent2: Sources say Roy Carson has had people knocking on his door to 'confront' him, Allisa hasn't been very vocal about the situation yet but hunter news is actively trying to reach out to her, so you - the reader stays updated about the situation.

ep4_intro.IntroText1: hey, I noticed you were requesting story submissions while I was watching a YouTuber play 'Fears to Fathom: Carson House'
ep4_intro.IntroText2: what I'm about to recount happened when I was 24 or so at the time
ep4_intro.IntroText3: it feels kind of weird telling anyone about this because of the bizarre and absurd nature of the whole thing
ep4_intro.IntroText4: but I feel like doing so might help me process my memories of it
ep4_intro.IntroText5: as im writing this, this was the scariest experience of my life
ep4_intro.IntroText6: I'm Jack Nelson, had a small job as a park ranger in a state park
ep4_intro.IntroText7: I was a fire lookout stationed in one of the largest forests in the pacific northwest
ep4_intro.IntroText8: miles and miles of dense forest managed by the forestry service
ep4_intro.IntroText9: I had a salary that allowed me to make ends meet
ep4_intro.IntroText10: but I couldn't afford to treat myself to restaurants, nice clothes, etc.
ep4_intro.IntroText11: my biggest accomplishment so far was being able to buy an RV for myself with a lot of financial help from my dad
ep4_intro.IntroText12: that RV was the only sense of home I had at the time.
ep4_intro.IntroText13: this one time I was transferred from one outpost to another because of some official circumstances
ep4_intro.IntroText14: it was a minor inconvenience to me though since I lived out of my RV and liked traveling
ep4_intro.IntroText15: I said a few goodbyes and I was off to the new location
ep4_intro.IntroText16: it was about a two hour drive.
ep4_intro.IntroText17: I want to include the location of this park but I dont want anyone seeking out seeking out the utter horrors ive seen in that forest
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro1: I couldn't shake the sense that something was terribly wrong
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro2: my mind couldn't help but think what might have happened
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro3: had the campers encountered an wild animal?
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro4: were they trying to hide from me?
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro5: or was it something far more sinister?
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro6: either way I had to report back to Connor
ep4_intro.Seq4Intro0\n: as I hiked back to my tower through the dark
ep4_intro.Seq6Intro0\n: next day I woke up not being so sure if last night was real or just a dream
ep4_intro.Seq6Intro1\n: connor tried to reason it as a harmless prank by some kids
ep4_intro.Seq6Intro2: but there's something about that night that just felt darker
ep4_intro.Seq6Intro3: there is something strange happening in those woods.
ep4_intro.Seq7Intro1: my unease was starting to grow with each passing day
ep4_intro.Seq7Intro2: so when I signed off that night, I told myself that it was just a change of environment that I needed getting used to
ep4_intro.Seq7Intro3: the strangeness id seen so far in those woods was not enough to cause an alarm yet
ep4_intro.Seq8Intro2: Connor's generator was under maintenance, which meant I had to cover his area for the past two days
ep4_intro.Seq8Intro3: when there were no fires going, the only thing I'd do is check in on connor twice a day
ep4_intro.Seq8Intro4: that might've been the only time I ever talked
ep4_intro.Seq8Intro5: .. unless I was talking to myself
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro2: I hit the gas and drove to the nearest ranger cabin
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro3: out of breath, I radioed in to alert the HQ
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro4: "look jack, we all get a little stir crazy out here", Mitch answered
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro5: next morning, authorities allegedly ran a small investigation of the area
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro6: but of course, they met with no signs of misconduct
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro7: no one ever believed my story, dismissing it as a product of isolation
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro8: "just stick to looking out for fires", Mitch offered
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro9: however, that was the last time I ever set my foot in those woods.
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro10: the unease still sits heavy in my stomach
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro11: even though many years have passed, the experience still feels vivid in my memory
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro12: my family thought I was making this whole thing up, which is really out of my character
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro13: but I know what I saw.
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro14: real or not - after dark, these woods can become a haven for illegal activities.
ep4_intro.Seq8Outro15: so if any of you plan on going camping soon
ep4_intro.IntroTextNew1: I knew that sharing this story anywhere else would be a dumb idea because people would say I was lying
